LEAID=3307360 | Pinkerton Academy School District, NEW HAMPSHIRE | Step 1
============================================================
Based on my research, I need to clarify an important finding: **Pinkerton Academy is an independent academy school district, not a traditional superintendent-led school district.** The top leader is **Dr. Timothy J. Powers, Head of School** [1], not a superintendent. [4]

Pinkerton Academy operates under a Board of Trustees governance structure rather than a traditional superintendent model. The school is governed by up to 18 volunteer trustees representing the sending towns (Derry, Hampstead, and Chester), and the Head of School manages operations under their direction [4]. Dr. Powers holds an Ed.D. from Walden University and a CAGS from Southern New Hampshire University [1].

The administrative team supporting Dr. Powers includes Michael Perez (Associate Head of School), Heather Barrieau (Dean of Support Services), Derek Lee (Dean of Academics), Dr. Jennifer Resmini (Dean of Faculty), and Stacey Silva (Chief Human Resources Officer) [1].

---

DISTRICT_CONFIRMED: Pinkerton Academy School District
SUPERINTENDENT_FULL_NAME: Dr. Timothy J. Powers (Head of School)
CONFIDENCE: high
CONFIDENCE_REASON: Current administrative information from official district website (dated December 31, 2025) confirms Dr. Timothy J. Powers as Head of School for the 2025–2026 school year. This is the highest K–12 administrative position in the district, as Pinkerton Academy operates as an independent academy under Board of Trustees governance, not under a superintendent model.

============================================================
**Dr. Matthew Cheeseman is the superintendent of Craven County Schools for the 2025–2026 school year (Aug 2025–Jun 2026), having assumed the role on February 1, 2026.** [1][5]

## Leadership Timeline

The November 2025 news article announces Sandra Beal's selection, but without a specific start date for her tenure, and given that we are now in February 2026, Sandra Beal would be the superintendent serving during the 2025–2026 school year if she has already assumed the position.

- **Mark Johnston** served as Superintendent and was recognized in 2023; he was hired in 2018 [2]
- **Sandra Beal** was selected as the new superintendent in November 2025 [1], having previously been Director of Curriculum/Grants/Federal Programs [7]

Given that Sandra Beal was selected in November 2025 and we are now in February 2026 (mid-school year), she would be the current superintendent for the 2025–2026 school year.
